video.title: Shape, Stroke & Path | Day 156
video.description:
Learn to explain how to draw custom forms in SwiftUI: Shape, Stroke & Path, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Shape - A protocol for a form that draws itself inside the space it is given.
Stroke - A line drawn along the edge of a shape, instead of filling the inside.
Path - A list of lines and curves that you build step by step to draw a custom form.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 156 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: SwiftUI Shape, Stroke & Path | Day 156
landscape.description:
Explain Shape, Stroke & Path in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
셰이프, 스트로크, 패스 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Shape - A protocol for a form that draws itself inside the space it is given.
한국어: 셰이프: 주어진 공간 안에 스스로 그려지는 도형을 위한 프로토콜

Stroke - A line drawn along the edge of a shape, instead of filling the inside.
한국어: 스트로크: 도형의 안쪽을 채우는 대신 가장자리를 따라 그리는 선

Path - A list of lines and curves that you build step by step to draw a custom form.
한국어: 패스: 직접 만든 도형을 그리기 위해 단계별로 쌓아 가는 선과 곡선의 목록

In this video, Mina and Jake build a custom badge form, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Shape, Stroke and Path in English?

dialogue.title: A custom badge

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I need a custom badge, not only a circle.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Create your own Shape. It draws itself inside the space it is given.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A Shape has one method, `path(in:)`, and it returns a Path.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A Path is a list of lines and curves, and you build it step by step.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: In my code I just return the whole `rect` as a Path.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is fine for a test. Later, add your own lines and curves.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I draw only the edge?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a Stroke. It draws a line along the edge instead of filling the inside.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I see! `lineWidth: 4` is the thickness of the Stroke.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. And one Shape can be used for fill and for Stroke.
Make the badge a custom Shape.
